prompted_for: 'The fabrication dossier' (svc-fabrication); art direction: editorial magazine spread, dramatic asymmetric layout, oversized light-weight headline cropped by the frame, one striking line-drawn figure, hairline rules; concept: huge light headline, dimensioned isometric PP pipe spool, four dossier parts in a split hairline grid
art_direction: isometric dimensioned pipe spool line drawing
composition: limestone page inside a thin navy outer frame
huge two-line light navy headline top-left filling ~55% width, not cropped
right ~45% upper: isometric drawing of a PP pipe spool with elbows, tees and flanged ends, dimension lines and arrows
five numbered items in a split grid: 01 and 02 under the headline, 03 bottom-left, 04 and 05 bottom-right, leaving an empty cell bottom-centre
each item topped by a hairline rule
layout_devices: split grid with a deliberate gap
dimension chains with arrows on the spool
palette: deep navy headline, text and thin outer frame
navy hairline drawing with pale blue-grey pipe fills
typography: huge light-weight sans headline in sentence case
rendering: isometric hairline line drawing with very light tonal fill on pipes
motion_implied: headline types in or fades up large
spool draws in with dimensions following
items reveal with their rules extending left to right
t2i_keywords: pale blue-grey tonal fill on pipes
numbered items with large light numerals
split grid with deliberate empty cell
t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as an editorial magazine spread on a warm limestone page with a thin navy outer frame. Small mono breadcrumb top-left, then a huge two-line light-weight navy sans headline. At upper right, one isometric hairline drawing of a white polypropylene pipe spool with elbows and tees, dimensioned with arrowed lines. Below, an asymmetric split grid of numbered items, each with a hairline rule above, a large light numeral, an uppercase mono label and a short line, for <CONTENT>. Generous space, flat, square corners.
signature_idea: A magazine-scale headline and one dimensioned PP spool frame the dossier as a set of numbered, ruled parts in an asymmetric grid.
strengths: huge light headline gives editorial presence with brand calm
isometric spool is on-offer PP piping, not generic equipment
numbered ruled items are simple and buildable
limestone plus navy ink is on-palette
lots of space as a material
weaknesses: headline is not cropped by the frame as prompted, so less dramatic
five items, not four, and the grid gap looks accidental
dimension numbers are random and meaningless
spool includes flange-like collars that read as metal fittings
brand_fit_why: Light huge headline, mono labels, navy on limestone, square corners and generous space are exactly the brand; only the missing accent and filler dimensions detract.
